jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Sticky Evidence
jokes.joke: I hired a nanny who treats every mess like a whodunit. I come home, there’s applesauce on the ceiling, and she lines up the toddlers like, “One of you had motive, access, and terrible grip strength.” Then she dusts the high chair for prints. Ma’am, they’re all sticky. That’s not evidence; that’s their whole personality.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Nanny Whodunit
jokes.joke: I hired a nanny who used to host murder mystery dinner parties for a living, and I did not think that through. Every bath time, she interrogates my toddler like there's a body in the tub. 'Where were you at 6 PM? Who had access to the rubber duck? Someone in this room is lying about eating the soap.' My son is two. He just confessed to everything just to make it stop.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Tactical DJ
jokes.joke: I went to a shooting range to feel tough, but it just sent me into a massive crisis of self-doubt. It’s impossible to feel like John Wick when you're wearing rented safety goggles over your prescription glasses and bright neon earmuffs that make you look like a tactical DJ. I paid fifty bucks just to violently flinch at my own weapon, miss a stationary piece of paper, and instinctively whisper, 'My bad,' every time I pulled the trigger.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Target Practice for the Soul
jokes.joke: I was experiencing a crisis of self-doubt last month, so I dragged myself to the shooting range thinking, 'This'll fix me—I'll feel like a total badass.' Folks, I missed every single target. The instructor finally walked over, looked at my scorecard, and said, 'Sir, at this point the paper is winning.' Now I'm back to doubting everything... including why I thought guns would help.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Identity Crisis at the Range
jokes.joke: I went to a shooting range to feel tough, but halfway through I had a full crisis of self-doubt. The instructor kept saying, “Trust yourself!” and I’m like, “Buddy, I don’t even trust myself to pick a Netflix show.” By the end, the target looked more confident than I did.
